podcast.title: 2000 Chart Presence
podcast.body: Eve 6 was cited as one of the bands on the charts in 2000 that, in the perception of some rock fans, offered only a limited number of strong songs across their discography, contributing to a general dissatisfaction with the state of rock. "If you look at the charts for 2000, we have bands like Mest, Eve 6, Fuel, Oliander, Lifhouse, Primitive Radio Gods, the Presidents of the United States of America."

podcast.title: Summersault Festival International Act
podcast.body: Eve 6 was an international act featured in Our Lady Peace's Summersault Festival lineup in 1998. "That lineup included I'm other Earth, McGandarves, as well as international flavor from Garbage, the Crystal Method and Eve 6."
